description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller 'ProductController' that exposes CRUD endpoints for managing 'Product' entities. It includes methods for creating, listing, retrieving by ID, updating, and deleting products, along with OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: ProductController
classes.description: REST controller exposing CRUD operations for products, handling HTTP requests at /api/products.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new product and returns the created product with location header.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all products.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its ID, throws ResourceNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing product by ID with new data.
